$comment: Topo3D overlay (SPEC P10.3). Applied on top of the OpenFreeMap Liberty style at runtime by site/topo3d.js. Values starting with $ are filled at runtime: $contourTiles (maplibre-contour protocol URL), $labelFont (font of the base style's labels, so glyphs exist), $nameExpr (Hebrew-first name). The page can export the fully merged style JSON.

dem.maxzoomNote: Owner run 2026-11-01: Meron tiles exist z10-13, 404 at z14-17. z13 at 512 px ≈ 8 m/px matches the 10 m isr10 DEM. z13 is NOT guaranteed outside covered areas, so the MAP stays at z12 (try ?demz=13 to compare); the elevation SAMPLER uses z13 and falls back to z12 on 404.
dem.attribution: Mapterhorn: 10 m DEM of Israel (isr10) — ASTER GDEM courtesy of METI and NASA processed by 4cast LTD; Copernicus GLO-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014, Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA

hideBaseLayers.$comment: Base layers replaced by Topo3D layers, matched by source-layer and filter text, not by id.

layers.$comment: Elevation colouring (MapLibre color-relief on the DEM; D-038). Off by default.
Slope angle classes computed in the browser from the DEM (site/terrain-derive.js; D-038).
Inner light line of the 4x4 track's double line (D-035).
Marked trails (OSM lwn hiking routes, e.g. Israel Trails Committee red/blue/green/black) in their marking colour, from z10 — before unmarked paths (z11) and small streams (z13). D-033.
National/regional hiking routes from the build-time OSM extract (D-032). National routes are the widest lines on the map (owner); the Israel National Trail is orange.
Thin trail name along the line, only from the ~200 m scale bar (z14.4 at Israel's latitude; owner).
Springs (from ~500 m scale), viewpoints and shelters (from ~300 m); icons keep their place, names only when there is room.

sky.$comment: Light horizon haze; fog only applies with 3D terrain.

satellite.$comment: D-017. Default provider works without an account. Keys are never stored in this repo.

providers.label: Sentinel-2 (EOX, 10 מ׳, בלי חשבון)

providers.note: URL pattern: OSM wiki 'Sentinel-2' (2018+ years). Licence: cloudless.eox.at non-commercial page. maxzoom 14 per Viewing products page; overzoomed beyond.

providers.label: Esri World Imagery (רזולוציה גבוהה)
providers.keyHelp: ArcGIS Location Platform API key, privilege: Location services → Basemaps → Static basemap tiles. Do NOT add a payment method: without pay-as-you-go, access just stops at the free limit.
providers.attribution: Powered by Esri · Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
providers.note: URL + attribution from developers.arcgis.com MapLibre tutorial (2026-11-01). tileSize and maxzoom not stated there: 256/18 chosen conservatively; verify on the owner's run.
providers.embeddedKeyNote: D-021: owner-approved public-application key, referrer-restricted to https://eliagil321hike-ops.github.io, Basemaps privilege only, no item access, no payment method (no charges possible), expires 2027-01-30. A key typed in the site overrides it.

providers.label: MapTiler Satellite (≈1 מ׳ במזה״ת, דורש מפתח)
providers.keyHelp: MapTiler Cloud free plan key (no payment method → the service pauses at the monthly limit, no charge)
providers.note: TileJSON URL pattern from docs.maptiler.com Tiles API; tileset satellite-v2 (zoom 0–22, ~1 m/px Middle East) from docs.maptiler.com schema-raster/satellite. Attribution and tile size come from the TileJSON at runtime; '© MapTiler' added as a minimum.

routing.$comment: D-026/D-027. openrouteservice foot-hiking. Owner's free Standard key embedded by owner decision (same trade-offs as D-021; no referrer restriction found). 2,000 directions/day, 40/minute.

poiNote: POI classes per the OpenMapTiles poi layer (class/subclass). OpenFreeMap tiles end at z14; at z13 the poi layer may be rank-limited, so not every POI shows before z14.
